scope: Independent source-only review; no product edits, no Oracle work and no duplicate test execution
decision: No static correctness blocker found; resource/performance acceptance remains separate

mutable_borrows_preserved: lease_names Arc by mutable reference, no Arc clone
cache Option of mutable reference, no snapshot
parameters.class_in: Recomputed from the same immutable question.class; no caller between the two reads can mutate it

preserved_boundaries: Both existing !owned returns remain before the helper; the first still calls answer_forward_rule and can return a domain/address answer.
Every header/flag/question/row-compression/TTL write and query-event operation remains in identical order.
Answer record_at/record_wire errors of every kind still set truncation; only the existing authority Full error is converted to truncation.
NX/SOA cache lookup still requires class-IN, preserve_negative_authority and no truncation; configured CNAME terminal validation remains distinct from opaque raw CNAME data.

Successful mail targets alone are remembered; append_mail_addresses remains unconditional after authority handling, including after truncation. Its hosts rotation, lease expiry and cache lookup/LRU side effects therefore still occur before RRset discard.
Final truncation still restores the question-only packet, clears AN/NS/AR and emits the same query event.
No clones, new heap objects, index mutation, lookup reordering or lifetime extension through returned references is introduced by the boundary.
resource_risks: The private helper is inline(never), not cold; all locally owned responses including hosts, configured CNAME, filtered/NOTIMP paths now cross this boundary.
Thirteen explicit arguments include vector descriptors and a result value; outgoing argument storage and caller/callee frames may overlap in the positive path.
Configured CNAME with leases can leave the original dotted-name Vec in the caller until return; tail-call elimination must not be assumed.

A smaller hot function does not prove smaller hot instruction working set, improved IPC, fewer dynamic spills or less aggregate stack. Inspect actual uninstrumented prologues and call/tail-call sites, then use separate controlled timings.
Final live allocation balance alone does not measure peak stack or heap; moving existing owning parameters is not proof of a performance gain.

existing_test_evidence.reason: The requested review was source-only and the unchanged body and existing completed tests supplied the necessary semantic evidence.

reviewed_existing_controls: CNAME chain and terminal authority handling
Additional cache pruning and sticky lease expiry
truncated answers still visiting successful mail targets
